fact: In Dodoma and Bahi, 53 and 47 facilities respectively initially could not enter their own data in DHIS2, and after HISP Tanzania training all public facilities in the two districts can now self-report on DHIS2, while elsewhere many facilities still rely on higher-level units for reporting.
title: Health Facility Level Digitalization
publisher: DHIS2 Community of Practice (HISP Tanzania, DHIS2 Annual Conference 2025)
